query: I planted a new batch of strawberry seedlings on my balcony last weekend, and I was so happy to see that three of them have already sprouted tiny new leaves this morning. I also tried a new matcha latte recipe yesterday, adding a little honey and oat milk, and it turned out way better than the ones I buy at the café down the street. Oh, and my cat knocked over a small potted succulent last night, I spent almost 20 minutes cleaning up the spilled soil off the floor. Anyway, I need to do an exchange for my delivered order #W6390527, I want to change the item 8384507844 to item 1569765161, and use paypal_7644869 as the payment method for any additional fees related to this exchange.
